title: Real-Time Visual Feedback to Guide Benchmark Creation: A Human-and-Metric-in-the-Loop Workflow

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating datasets during the crowdsourcing creation phase using a Data Quality Index (DQI) that measures seven linguistic properties (e.g., vocabulary distribution, intra- and inter-sample semantic textual similarity, n-gram frequency per label) to quantify unintended correlations and heuristics.
Integrating probabilistic mutual information (PMI) into the DQI visual feedback mechanism to explicitly identify and discourage the creation of NLI samples that contain stereotyped associations.
